headline: March 14: 2027 SSC exams rescheduled to start
summary: The theoretical exams will conclude on April 15, with practicals to be completed by April 22.
details: The schedule for the 2027 Secondary School Certificate (SSC) and equivalent examinations has been released. The exams will begin on March 14 with the Bengali (Compulsory) first paper and end on April 15.
Theoretical exams will conclude by April 15, and all practical examinations must be completed and marks submitted online by April 22.

The schedule was finalized by the Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee on Monday, August 24, and subsequently approved by the Secondary and Higher Education Division of the Ministry of Education.
Previously, Education Minister A N M Ehsanul Haq Miloon had suggested that the exams would take place in January. However, this decision faced criticism from students, parents, and educators.
Following discussions and considering the feedback from stakeholders, the Education Minister stated on June 2, that the decision could be reconsidered.
The final decision to hold the exams in March was made specifically to avoid conflicts with the holy month of Ramadan and Eid-ul-Fitr.
caption:
SSC exams are moving to March! The 2027 schedule is officially out.

The schedule for the 2027 Secondary School Certificate (SSC) and equivalent examinations has been released. The exams will begin on March 14 with the Bengali (Compulsory) first paper and end on April 15.

Theoretical exams will conclude by April 15, and all practical examinations must be completed and marks submitted online by April 22.

The schedule was finalized by the Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee on Monday, August 24, and subsequently approved by the Secondary and Higher Education Division of the Ministry of Education.

Previously, Education Minister A N M Ehsanul Haq Miloon had suggested that the exams would take place in January. However, this decision faced criticism from students, parents, and educators.

Following discussions and considering the feedback from stakeholders, the Education Minister stated on June 2, that the decision could be reconsidered.

The final decision to hold the exams in March was made specifically to avoid conflicts with the holy month of Ramadan and Eid-ul-Fitr.

headline_marked: 938 children dead as [[measles death toll rises]] in Bangladesh
headline: 938 children dead as measles death toll rises in Bangladesh
summary: Five more children died in the last 24 hours, while 1,232 others were hospitalized with measles symptoms across the country.
details: Five children died within the last 24 hours across Bangladesh showing symptoms of measles, according to a report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
In the same period, 1,232 children were admitted to hospitals with measles and measles-like symptoms.
Since March 15, a total of 839 children have died with measles symptoms, while 99 children have died from confirmed measles cases.
The total death toll from measles and measles-like symptoms since mid-March stands at 938 children.
